description: Maximum CMBS loan on a property under the three sizing tests lenders apply, and which one binds: loan to value x value, NOI / (DSCR x annual debt constant at the rate and amortization, or the rate if interest-only), and NOI / debt yield. Limits you omit default to what recent CMBS loans stayed within (90th percentile LTV, 10th percentile DSCR and debt yield, by property type), and the rate to the 90-day median.

amortization_years.description: Amortization schedule in years. Required when interest_only is false.

interest_only.description: true = interest-only for the full term (most recent CMBS loans). Default true.

max_ltv_pct.description: Maximum loan to value in percent, e.g. 65.

min_debt_yield_pct.description: Minimum debt yield in percent, e.g. 8.5.

min_dscr.description: Minimum debt service coverage ratio, e.g. 1.30.

noi.description: Underwritten net operating income (or net cash flow) per year in dollars, e.g. 1800000.

property_type.description: Property type: multifamily, retail, office, hotel, self-storage, industrial, mixed-use, mobile-home-park, co-op, healthcare. Omit for all types.

property_value.description: Appraised value or purchase price in dollars, e.g. 25000000.

rate_pct.description: Note rate in percent, e.g. 6.5. Default: the 90-day median CMBS rate for the property type.

name: size_cmbs_loan
title: Size a CMBS loan
